findings.finding: The package wiring test checks only that dev and build contain the sync command. It does not assert that dev runs kill-port before sync and server.js after sync, or that build runs sync before Next build and standalone hydration.
findings.impact: A future reordering could satisfy the test while allowing the server or build to start before the generated browser manifest exists.
findings.requiredAction: Add order assertions or a small command-token contract if this workflow remains a maintained gate.
